# NumisGallery

NumisGallery (https://numisgallery.com) is a web application for cataloging, organizing, and showcasing banknote collections. It is operated by Happy Haiku LLC.

## Product

Collectors and dealers use NumisGallery to:

- Catalog PMG-certified banknotes by certification number and grade
- Fetch high-resolution obverse and reverse images from PMG
- Auto-extract country, denomination, serial numbers, and other details with AI
- Organize world banknotes (Pick numbers) and US currency (Friedberg numbers)
- Export collections to CSV or PDF
- Share a public gallery of paper money

## Public pages

Free accounts include up to 50 banknotes. Pro is $4.99/month or $49/year.
